{{Quote|Interesting. We have finished studying the holocron that Shoran found. It speaks of an ancient grove nearby.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=AncientGroveStudy.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
An '''ancient grove''' associated with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. It contained several ruined structures and was described in a [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|Jedi holocron]]. The grove was accessible by a path through a [[Forest/Legends|forest]], although the entrance to it was covered by a line of [[Tree/Legends|trees]].

==Description==
The ancient grove was located within a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. A narrow path led to it, although the entrance was covered with a line of [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. The center of the grove rested on a slightly elevated stretch of land and was surrounded by [[Flower/Legends|flowers]], with patches of a stone path leading there. At the center were two ruined stone structures and a remnant of a wall.<ref name="GB" />

The grove also contained two narrow rectangular [[Water/Legends|pools]] paved with stone, one stretching from the northeastern to the north side of the ruins, and another from the north to the northwestern side. Each pool was surrounded by a line of trees on one side, and in between them was another ruined piece of a wall. [[Mynock/Legends|Mynocks]] were present at the grove, and one of the pools supported [[Fish/Legends|fish]].<ref name="GB" />

==History==
The ancient grove had a connection to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and information concerning it was recorded in a [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|Jedi holocron]] on Alaris Prime. During the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonization]] of the moon<ref name="GB" /> between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], during which the [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|holocron]] was discovered, between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].</ref> the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] was discovered in the [[Shoran's camp|camp]] of the Wookiee [[Shoran]], and was brought to a [[Jedi temple (Alaris Prime)|Jedi temple]] built to store it.<ref name="GB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
During the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]], in which the Wookiees fought against the forces of their [[Colonist/Legends|colonial]] rivals, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], studies of the holocron were completed, revealing that the ancient grove was situated near a Wookiee [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|base]]. The Wookiees removed the trees blocking the path to the grove and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who had landed at the base to aid the Wookiees, visited it. There, he discovered the ancient knowledge of [[Jedi Concentration]], allowing him to convert the Federation buildings to the Wookiee side through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="GB" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I've discovered ancient knowledge. Jedi Concentration, this is a fantastic find! With this knowledge I can convert enemy buildings to our side.|Qui-Gon Jinn, if the player finds the ancient grove|audio=JediConcentration.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The ancient grove appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' in the seventh and final level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "The Battle for Alaris Prime." Discovering the grove and sending Qui-Gon Jinn there automatically gives the player the ability of Jedi Concentration, which is available for research at the [[Jedi temple/Legends|Jedi temples]] of some civilizations in the standard game mode, but is otherwise inaccessible within the level.<ref name="GB" />
